scenario: DS-source twin of the K vector formal/k/rgate.cool_perkey: two keys asserted in one pump both fire -- cooldown state is per activation key (LCDB.3.3.3, RLOW.4.6.2.3), and the key is the declared key slot (LCDB.3.3.1). Drives adapter_ds_rate_allow (rete/adapters.c) with two distinct entries (r, 1) and (r, 2), each on its no-prior-fire path. The order of the two messages is LDET.5.5 creation order, which the existing temporal/LCDB.7.1 fixture pins by count only; this one pins the sequence.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule r cooldown 10_s:
    Trig t
->
    log info "fire {t.k}"
